svg.text: Municipal WWTP Upgrade — Process Flow Diagram
5,000 m³/d municipal wastewater treatment plant, Shanxi Province, China · standards upgrade to GB 18918-2002 Class 1A with provincial NH₃-N / TP limits (DB 14/1928-2019)
Diagram redrawn by Yizhou Pan from own design work, 2021 · simplified for portfolio use
AAO BIOLOGICAL POOL · CONVERTED FROM AO
All values mg/L. NH₃-N and TP to provincial standard DB 14/1928-2019 Table 2.
AO → AAO conversion — anaerobic zone added for enhanced TN & TP removal
New denitrification deep-bed filter — tertiary nitrogen polishing to meet tightened limits
Pump ratings re-evaluated & retrofitted — oversized units replaced — 10% plant electricity saving
